group.name: Banking & Insurance
group.intro: Bank pay follows the bank wage settlement, so salaries are approximate starting gross amounts. Negative marking is 0.25 of the question's marks. Age relaxation: OBC 3, SC/ST 5, PwBD 10 (+3 OBC, +5 SC/ST), ex-servicemen 5. Recent IBPS and SBI notices have included a credit-history (CIBIL) condition at the time of joining; the exact rule differs by notice, so read it in yours.

notes: Final-year students can usually apply for graduate exams if they will have the degree by the cut-off date in the notice.
EWS gets reservation but no age relaxation in bank exams.
Persons affected by the 1984 riots: +5 years.
Widows, divorced women and judicially separated women: up to 35 (UR), 38 (OBC), 40 (SC/ST) in many clerk notices.
Attempt limits: SBI PO allows 4 attempts for General, 7 for OBC and unlimited for SC/ST. RBI Grade B allows 6 attempts for General / EWS.
